shared.content: Use British English spelling (colour, favourite, centre, organise, defence).

match-preview.content: Keep the preview body to at most 120 words.
Mention the format (T20) in the opening sentence and give the start time with its time zone, as in "19:30 IST".
Never use betting language: no odds, bets, wagers, tips, punts or bookmakers.
Measured, knowledgeable tone; no hype words such as 'epic' or 'mouth-watering'.

sitemap.content: Header menu order: Home, News, Fixtures, Squad, Standings, Videos, Photos.
When the club has a cricket team, give it Fixtures, Squad, Standings and Statistics pages, with the standard slugs.
The club site has a Fan Zone page only when the brief asks for one.
